Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
We care about our tokens here at Secret Lair. Sure, sometimes we use whatever random tokens are nearby on the table, and in a pinch, yes, we’ll throw a rubber band or a nickel out there. But given the choice, we’re bringing something really sick to the table and turning heads. Look sharp, play sharp.
Inspired by the unthinkably cool food packaging we saw on our last trip to Japan, we created these wild Food tokens. What do you think?
